newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA TO HANDLE KEILA CP ISSUES.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA TO HANDLE KEILA CP ISSUES.

text.p: Tallinna Pank said on Wednesday it will handle a 10-year commercial paper programme by Keila town government.
According to the programme, the small town located near Tallinn will issue six-month commercial papers, the bank added in a statement.
The first issue is worth 13.5 million kroons and has a yield of eight percent.
Keila will use the loan to refinance its previous loans and for the reconstruction of buildings, the bank added.
